CareEventInput.description: One care event of a batch.

idempotency_key.description:
Per-event key, unique per org: an event whose key was stored before is counted as a
duplicate and not stored again.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (RFC 3339); the server's receive time when absent.

payload.description:
Free-form event body. Tasks carry `task_id` and optional `metadata.type`
(`session`, `checkin`); diary entries carry `mood`. Must be a JSON object.

duplicate.description: True when the whole batch was a replay of an earlier `X-Idempotency-Key`.

duplicates.description: Events skipped because their `idempotency_key` was already stored.

CareSummary.description:
`GET /v1/participants/{token}/summary`: counts over the participant's care events. An
unknown token answers all zeros (the old CareKit summary did the same).

completion_rate_percent.description: 100 when any task was completed, else 0 (the CareKit port's rule).

recent_moods.description: Distinct diary moods, newest first (at most 10).

session_count.description: Task events whose `task_id` contains `session` or whose `metadata.type` is `session`.

assigned_to.description: Assign to this user of the org instead of the caller.

ClinicalNote.description: A clinical note. Append-only: a correction is a new note with `corrects_id`.

corrected_by.description: The id of the note that corrects this one, if any (shown struck through).

ClinicalNoteKind.description: NOTE-1: a correction is a new note pointing at the corrected one.

ClinicalReview.description: `GET /v1/clinical-reviews/{id}` and the result of every review mutation.

content_hash.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the current version's snapshot; sign and cosign must echo it
(SIGN-4).

current.description: The version being edited or the latest signed one.

ClinicalReviewSnapshot.description:
SIGN-4: exactly what the signer saw. `content_hash = SHA-256(JCS(snapshot))`. Every field
is serialised (absent values as `null`), so adding a field to this type changes every
hash: version it rather than editing it.

ClinicalReviewVersion.description: One version of a review's content.

amend_reason.description: SIGN-8 reason of an amendment version; absent without `ClinicalContentRead`.

ClinicalSignature.description:
One signature (SIGN-5, SIGN-6). The name and registration are a snapshot taken at
signing (signature manifestation).

content_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the signed snapshot.

ClipScore.description:
`GET /v1/sessions/{id}/clips` item: the stored per-clip row plus its metric rows. The
flat `metric/expected/recorded/deviation/baseline_ref` columns come from the worst-status
row (ties: largest |deviation|), all `null` for a clip without rows (CON-19).

status.description: Worst row status; `null` for a clip with no scored rows.

ConfigBundle.description:
The signed bundle served by `GET /v1/config/bundle` (CON-5, CON-6).

`signature` is `ed25519:` + base64url (no padding) of the Ed25519 signature over the
RFC 8785 canonical form of this object with the `signature` member removed; `key_id`
names the signing key so keys can rotate. Use [`crate::signing`] to sign and verify.
ConfigBundle.title: ConfigBundle

ConfigDocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle `draft -> candidate -> published -> retired`; only `published` is bundled.

Disposition.description: SIGN-2: the clinician's statement. Never pre-filled from the attention flag.

DwellUnits.description: Units of the `dwell_*` columns. Ratios of valid clip samples, never seconds (CON-13).

EnrolCodeResponse.description: The new enrol code; the plain code is returned only here.

ErasureRequestResponse.description:
`POST /v1/participants/{token}/erasure`: the stored request (execution is a job,
WP-B.9). Consent is withdrawn at once, so no new data is accepted for the participant.

duplicate.description: True when an open request already existed and is returned unchanged.

atypicalShareForRed.description: Share of atypical rows that forces red even with a high composite.

greenFloor.description: Composite at or above which the flag can be green.

lowConfidenceShare.description: Share of scored clips below the quality gate that forces yellow.

yellowFloor.description: Composite below which the flag is red.

GazeSessionRecord.description:
The full on-device record (`GazeSessionRecord.swift`), carried as `rawPayload`.

Dates are RFC 3339 UTC strings with milliseconds (`2026-10-26T07:33:20.000Z`), as
`SessionPayloadCoding` writes them. Keys this type does not know (for example a future
`bundleVersion` or `normCollection`) are kept in [`GazeSessionRecord::extra`] and written
back unchanged, so `sessions.summary` stores the record without loss.

participantId.description: Pseudonymous participant token, never a name (CNS-7).

schemaVersion.description: Record form (`"v1.6"`); the wire form drops the `v`.

name.description: JSON pointer or field name, e.g. `sessionId` or `/perVideo/0/dwell_social`.

LabelInput.description: A human annotation attached by a reviewer.

LetterSnapshot.description: NOTE-3: what a letter's finalizer signs.

MetricRow.description: One scored expected-vs-recorded cell of a clip (CON-19).

deviation.description: `recorded - expected`; `null` when there is no expected value.

display_name.description: Signer profile (NOTE-6); staff data, stored in clear.

has_patient_ref.description:
Whether a hospital MRN is on file (MRN-5/6). Absent for a caller without
`PatientRefRead`; the MRN itself is never in this type.

PatientRefSearchRequest.description: `POST /v1/orgs/{id}/patient-refs/search`: the MRN travels in the body only (MRN-4).

PatientRefSearchResponse.description: Search result: the matching participant, or `null`.

ProblemSlug.description: Problem slugs defined by the contract: `Problem.type` is `https://schemas.curv.org/asd/problems/<slug>`. Routes may add their own (e.g. `email-taken`, `last-owner`).

Ready.description:
`GET /health/ready` (DB and blob store, CON-22). `status` is `ok` only when every
check is `ok`; the HTTP status is 503 otherwise.

content_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the letter snapshot; finalize must echo it.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: `POST /v1/devices/register` body as the iOS app sends it.

device_id.description:
Sent on re-registration: the server rotates this device's token without consuming
a use of the code (CON-11).

config_bundle_version.description: Latest bundle for the org, `null` when none is published.

device_token.description: `dvc_` + 32 random bytes base64url; shown once, stored hashed.

RegistrationStatus.description: Whether a registration created a device or rotated an existing device's token.

ReviewReason.description: Why a session entered the review queue.

Role.description: RBAC role: org-scoped roles plus the global `superadmin` (AUTH-4).

ScoringProfile.description: Scoring parameters delivered in the bundle (`scoring_profile` config document).

lowConfidenceValidRatio.description: Clips below this valid-sample ratio are low-confidence.

trackingQuality.description: Gaze-robustness thresholds (SCH-3). Absent in a 1.0.0 profile: the asd-core defaults.

SessionAttentionFlag.description: Backend-derived flag: the device enum plus `unreliable` (CON-15).

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

SessionIngestRequest.description: Curv Pediatric ASD Gaze Session Ingestion Schema (v1.6)

attentionFlag.description:
Explicit `null` when the device did not compute a flag; the server then derives it
(CON-15). `None` = key absent, `Some(None)` = `null`.

battery.description: Catalog protocol id (`express_30s`, CON-16) or explicit `null` when unknown.

schemaVersion.description: Wire form (`"1.6"`), equal to the `X-Schema-Version` header (CON-21).

SessionIngestRequest.title: SessionIngestRequest

SessionIngestResponse.description:
`POST /v1/sessions` success body. Key casing follows the iOS decoder
(`sessionId`, `frames_upload_url`). A replay returns the original body with
`duplicate: true` (CON-17). Upload URLs are absolute pre-signed URLs or relative
`/v1/sessions/{id}/blobs/{frames|report}` paths (CON-18); `null` when no upload is wanted.

SessionIngestStatus.description: Outcome recorded for an accepted session.

SessionPerVideoScore.description:
One flattened per-clip row (`SessionPerVideoRow` in Swift; schema name
`SessionPerVideoScore`, which the Swift schema test looks up by name). snake_case.

A metric the clip did not measure, or measured only by imputation, is an absent key.

orienting_latency_ms.description: Measured first-entry latency; an imputed latency is not sent.

status.description: Worst row status of the clip; absent when the clip has no scored rows.

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

SignRequest.description:
Step-up signing body (SIGN-5), used by sign, cosign and letter finalize. The password
is verified and dropped; it is never stored or logged.

totp_code.description: Required when the user has TOTP enrolled.

SnapshotClip.description: One clip of the snapshot: every stored `MetricRow`, in display order.

SnapshotMeasurements.description: The stored session measurements shown on the review page (`SessionDetail` fields).

TimelineEntry.description: One timeline entry: headers only, never a note or letter body (CW-3).

id.description: Id of the underlying row (session id, review id, note id, letter id, care event id).

summary.description:
Kind-specific header: e.g. `{"attention_flag": "red"}`, `{"state": "final",
"version_no": 2}`, `{"note_kind": "general"}`, `{"letter_kind": "referral",
"status": "final"}`, `{"care_kind": "diary"}`. Never free text.

TrackingQualityParams.description:
Every threshold of the gaze-robustness spec (SCH-3). Each member is optional; a missing
member takes the default shown.

provisional.description: `true` until the bench replaces the literature defaults (BEN-6).

UpdateProfileRequest.description:
`PATCH /v1/users/me`. Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear. Unknown fields are rejected
(role and status are never self-service).

display_name.description: Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear; up to 120 characters (NOTE-6).

professional_registration.description: Absent = unchanged, `""` = clear; up to 60 characters (NOTE-6).

org_id.description: `null` only for the global `superadmin`, who belongs to no org (AUTH-4).

UserProfile.description: `GET /v1/users/me`: the caller's account and signer profile.

UserStatus.description:
User account status. `invited` accounts exist but cannot sign in yet; only `active`
users can.

WorklistItem.description:
`GET /v1/orgs/{id}/worklist` item: the session plus its clinical review state. Never
carries impression or MRN (RBAC-4).

age_hours.description: Hours since the session was received.

participant_token.description: The pseudonymous token the device sent (CON-20).

review_id.description: `null` when no clinician has opened the review yet.

WorklistScope.description:
CW-2 `settings.clinical.worklist_scope`; default `all` for clinic orgs, `flagged`
otherwise.

description: Request and response bodies of the ASD backend `/v1` API. Errors are `Problem` (application/problem+json). Each type is under `$defs`.
